name: Hiiragi Nanase
source: Pretends to be [url=/c1345]Hinata[/url]'s daughter and calls her "Mama" but in fact her younger sister. Not familiar with strangers, especially males. Was cold towards [url=/c1344]Natsuki[/url] at first thinking he's trying to steal her mama. Became friends with [url=/c1350]Koharu[/url].
